answer: A newcomer plants a cedar post, locks a 70-credit bond, and needs five neighbors to co-sign, each staking 12. Endorsements ebb with the tide, halving every 10 epochs unless renewed by a check; rented quorums rot. Each epoch a gale sweep re-checks 5% of posts; failure burns the bond, slashes endorsers 24 each. Fee ladder 30+4(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,028,000, stake 60,000, lock 70,000, vs 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps the bond.
